behavior: Broker-owned USB rows show the owning connection state and cannot prepare another Connect until exact native and control retirement. Refresh preserves physical-key correlation.
regression_before_fix: Controller inventory row prepared a duplicate Connect
GUI row lacked Connected and enabled Connect

coverage.method: Fresh instrumented target; source fingerprints verified; per-function LCOV gate, no exclusions.

ownership.owner: Existing Controller link owns its physical key; snapshot is an immutable projection.
ownership.bounds: 512 device records and existing link capacity; optional counter is bounded by MAX_COUNTER. No new native allocations, tasks or leases.
ownership.cutoff: Connect preparation rejects any owned row. Inventory refresh cannot retire a link.
ownership.settlement: collect_retired retains the original link until its control lease and attached native Completion retire. Cancellation and quarantine remain owned.
ownership.invariants: Each row references at most one existing link; duplicate/missing owner references reject the complete snapshot. No borrowed link or device pointer escapes.
ownership.tests: Permanent refresh, duplicate-connect, approval, authentication, quarantine, native-proof and lease-retirement tests.

limits: ADB reservations are tracked separately under T1338; this commit covers broker-owned links.
Linux widget tests pass; native Windows evidence remains T1271.
